title: Geo-sensitive private deploys: fast-track gating + compatibility checklist
creator: Lucas Nguyen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers operating under geo-residency, data localization, or government network constraints request accelerated Private/VPC/on-prem seats. Current intake routes are lengthy and inconsistent across regions; customers are blocked while legal, networking, and infra compatibility are validated serially. Goal: define a repeatable fast-track gating and compatibility checklist for geo-sensitive private deployments that shortens turnaround for eligible customers while preserving security and upgrade safety. Deliverables: 1) A triage rubric that scores requests for fast-track eligibility (compliance, revenue, risk, region readiness); 2) A preflight compatibility checklist with automated probes and minimum network diagram requirements; 3) Standard communication templates and escalation path (PM -> Solutions -> Eng -> Security -> Legal); 4) A lightweight approval artifact (signed runbook + triage score) that can be stored in customer case for audits.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Triage rubric documented and validated with Solutions and Security, with thresholds defined for 'fast-track' vs 'standard'. 2) Preflight checklist contains concrete probes (CIDR, egress, TLS, KMS endpoints, NTP, packaging/airgap constraints) and a one-click probe script for common cloud setups. 3) Two pilot customer requests run through the process end-to-end within 3 weeks and closed with time-to-onboard measured. 4) Communication templates for customer emails, internal escalation, and a one-page readiness report created and reviewed. 5) Hand-off checklist for Engineering and Deploy Ops with clear rollback/upgrade window guidance created.
out_of_scope: Full automation of private installer, persistent on-prem installation support, or new contractual SLA changes. Deep legal reviews for non-standard regulatory regimes (those remain standard off-ramp). Large migrations that require multi-month network changes are not eligible for fast-track and will be routed to standard onboarding lanes.
